scope: Pure NumPy reconstruction of frozen arrays plus installed-source read. Diagnostic matrix algebra is localization evidence only, not a corrected physical Hessian.
units: curvature and Hq in Eh/Bohr^2; Cartesian directions have Euclidean Frobenius norm1

formulas.diagnostic_blockdiag_only: h_diagtest_ij = h_ij for i != j; h_diagtest_ii = h_ii - (R_i+R_i.T)/2. No matrix is saved or substituted into original science.
formulas.translation: T = tile(I_3,(N,1))/sqrt(N); translation invariant Cartesian Hessian should satisfy A@T=0.
formulas.projection_only: P=I-T@T.T; compare q.T@P@A@P@q to distinguish whole-molecule translation contamination from local block-diagonal defect.
formulas.nuclear_pair: K_ij=Zi*Zj*(3*r_ij*r_ij.T/r^5-I/r^3); add K to ii,jj and -K to ij,ji.
formulas.CPHF_residual: r_ai=(eps_a-eps_i)*U_ai+H1_ai-S1_ai*eps_i+V(U)_ai; separately maxabs(U_oo+S1_oo/2). Re-evaluate V with returned U, not Krylov internal estimate.

source_audit.finding: get_veff only initializes grid if coords is None. initialize_grids only builds/prunes when coords is None; preassigned arrays bypass build and density pruning.

Noresponse gradient uses _initialize_grids: explicit grad.grids, else base.grids; only rebuilds if coords is None. Full grid response changes the derivative semantics and must be False in frozen-grid test.

Assigning level/prune/atom_grid and other generating options resets arrays. Set options before injecting frozen coords/weights. make_mask is evaluated on current displaced molecule. screen_index and non0tab are geometry-dependent.
PBE/GGA analytic Hessian helper integrals use the same fixed hessobj.grids or base.grids arrays; no semilocal moving-grid response branch in these helpers.

solve_mo1 multiplies tol by atom block size. gen_hop precomputes full partial Hessian and h1 for all atoms; its cphf.solve call does not pass hessian maxcycle/tol. Prefer explicit selected-direction solve with fresh residual.
stock RHF/RKS get_jk may construct incore ERI even when direct_scf=True; direct-only comparison must bind hf.SCF.get_jk to stock RKS.

frozen_grid_API.center: Run or rebuild matching center SCF once, then copy actual center.mf.grids.coords/weights after convergence; preserve pruning and actual grid order. Original checkpoint does not store these grid arrays.
frozen_grid_API.displaced: Create fresh mf at R0 +/- h*q. Set all level/prune/radii options first. Then mf.grids.mol=pointmol; coords/weights=copied center arrays; non0tab=mf.grids.make_mask(pointmol,coords); screen_index=non0tab. Never call reset/build after array injection.
frozen_grid_API.gradient: grad=mf.nuc_grad_method();grad.grid_response=False;grad.grids=mf.grids; g=grad.kernel(). Confirm same coordinates/weights checksums immediately before/after SCF and gradient.
frozen_grid_API.metadata: Copy atm_idx/quadrature_weights if available for completeness. Do not enable full grid response for fixed-grid comparison. Reuse same center E0 from the frozen-grid group.
frozen_grid_API.pruning: coords != None bypasses initialize_grids and its density pruning, so retaining original small_rho_cutoff avoids introducing another settings change.
frozen_grid_API.masks: Never reuse center non0tab/screen_index for displaced molecule. Recompute with current molecule or set both None to force unscreened AO path; record chosen path.

ranked_tests.name: water fixed-grid translation paired FD at h=.005,.01
ranked_tests.scope: 4 displaced SCF+gradient points plus matching center/grid cache; compare fixed-grid cE/cG with original cA=-.022132923633604355 and existing moving-grid approximately zero.
ranked_tests.decisive_outcome: Fixed-grid cE/cG agreeing with cA, while regrid differs, identifies discrete fixed-grid vs moving-grid second derivative as primary cause for that test. If fixed-grid still disagrees, inspect implementation/response.

ranked_tests.name: same center MO+DM+grid stock-direct/wrapper gen_response and gen_vind
ranked_tests.scope: No geometry optimization. Bind MethodType(hf.SCF.get_jk,stock). Compare identical test dm1/U before/after stock._opt={None:None}. Compare returned potentials H1s/response; preserve MO/grid settings.
ranked_tests.decisive_outcome: Nonzero wrapper-vs-stock difference at fixed inputs implicates dispatch/cache/wrapper layer; numerical agreement strongly reduces that hypothesis.

ranked_tests.name: water translation+mode1 selected-direction CPHF residual
ranked_tests.scope: make_h1 all atoms once, contract H1q=sum(q_ia*H1_ia), S1q=sum(q_ia*S1_ia), transform C.T@H1q@Cocc etc; explicit cphf.solve tol1e-8 and1e-10,maxcycle100,levelshift0; fresh residual and response contribution.
ranked_tests.decisive_outcome: Small residual and stable response under tighter tolerance reject ordinary CPHF truncation as source of large H error; large residual or huge U requires conditioning/stability investigation.

ranked_tests.name: acid mode1 frozen-grid two-step pair after water decision
ranked_tests.scope: 4 displaced points and center only if water fixed-grid attribution succeeds or remains inconclusive. Escalate calycosin only if acid fails to generalize.

interpretation: Large original Hq-vs-FD errors collapse after subtracting local symmetric row-sum blocks, including positive frequency control directions. The main discrepancy is strongly consistent with local block-diagonal translational-sum-rule terms.

Whole-molecule translation projection alone does not change negative selected acid/calycosin curvatures to positive. This is not explained by simply including translational eigenmodes in a frequency diagonalization.
Nuclear Coulomb Hessian alone satisfies translational invariance to machine precision; total translation error lies in electronic contributions.

Fixed-grid vs moving-grid semantics is now a high-priority testable cause, not yet experimentally established. A small first-derivative grid-response change does not bound the second derivative of that change.
limits: Do not use the diagnostic block-diagonal adjustment as a replacement Hessian or minimum certificate. It enforces a condition by construction and does not establish its unique physical origin.

Original analytic SCF1e-8 and existing finite-difference SCF1e-10 differ. Future fixed-grid comparisons must keep center/plus/minus SCF settings identical and record this original-reference limitation.
Only selected directions tested; no corrected full spectrum. No Q calls performed in this review.
